user.title: Set Up Abstractor
user.description: Creates the Abstractor root entry. Add individual Abstract sensors afterwards from the integration's device page.

error.source_required: Select at least one source entity.

init.title: Abstractor options
init.description: Configure polling, InfluxDB export, and device presentation.

data_description.poll_interval: Choose a preset or select custom for a bounded interval.
data_description.influx_host: InfluxDB base URL. Export is enabled only with a token.
data_description.influx_token: InfluxDB API token. It is masked in the UI and diagnostics.
data_description.device_name: Device name, with {device_type} replaced by the sensor type.
data_description.device_manufacturer: Manufacturer shown in Home Assistant device details.
data_description.device_model: Model shown in Home Assistant device details.
data_description.naming_template: Local naming template applied to device and entity names, and to the suggested entity_id. Add YAML files under config/abstractor/templates/ to offer your own; use 'default' for the built-in behaviour.
data_description.debug_switch_entity_id: input_boolean that gates debug notifications. Leave empty to keep debug notifications off.
data_description.notify_entity_id: Notify entity that receives debug notifications while the debug switch is on.

poll_interval.title: Custom polling interval
poll_interval.description: Choose a value between 1 and 3600 seconds.

error.invalid_influx_host: InfluxDB host must start with http:// or https://

error.device_mapping_conflict: This device is owned by another Abstractor sensor. Bundling is blocked because Home Assistant could delete that sensor and its recorder history. Choose a device owned by this sensor or create a separate device.

user.title: Add Abstract sensor
user.description: Choose the type of abstract sensor to add.

data_description.device_type: Power, energy, water, or a binary sensor type.

details.title: Configure Abstract sensor
details.description: Choose the hardware source(s) and, for numeric sensors, the value pipeline.

data_description.source_entity_ids: Select one or more entities to sum. Use this instead of the single-source field for aggregation.
data_description.legacy_unique_id: Manually reuse a specific unique_id (e.g. from a migrated YAML template sensor). Leave blank to have one generated automatically — either way, this sensor's identity will never change again, even if you later swap its source hardware.
data_description.aggregation: How multiple sources are combined into one value: sum (default) adds all sources, max/min take the highest/lowest source, first_available takes the first source that delivers a value.
data_description.spike_filter: Reject drops below the last valid value (recommended for energy and water counters).
data_description.invert: Multiply the value by -1 (e.g. net flow: load minus feed-in).
data_description.fallback_zero: Report 0 instead of unavailable when no source delivers a value.
data_description.fallback_on_zero: Also use the fallback source when the aggregate is exactly 0 (template idiom 'primary == 0 -> fallback', e.g. ACE 1500 discharge).
data_description.net_subtract_entity_id: Subtracted from the aggregate after summing, e.g. charge minus discharge.
data_description.fallback_source_entity_id: Alternate hardware source used when the primary is unavailable and the condition below is met.
data_description.fallback_condition_entity_id: Optional entity whose state gates the fallback. Leave empty to always allow the fallback.
data_description.fallback_condition_state: State the condition entity must match for the fallback to activate.
data_description.target_device_id: Add this sensor to an existing Abstractor device.
data_description.create_new_device: Detach this sensor from its current device and create a separate device.
data_description.logical_name: Overrides the device name for this sensor's device group. Leave empty to use the configured device name template.
data_description.entity_name: Overrides this entity's friendly name. Leave empty to use the localized default.
data_description.object_id: Suggested entity_id (slug). Applied only when the entity is first created; renaming an existing entity uses the rename action.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Abstract sensor
reconfigure.description: Change the source entities, move this sensor to a different device, or adjust the value pipeline.

data_description.device_type: Power, energy, or water abstraction layer.

data_description.legacy_unique_id: Reuse the unique_id of a migrated YAML template sensor so recorder history keeps counting. Once set it becomes this sensor's identity and is no longer shown here, because changing it would orphan the entity and its history.

data_description.spike_filter: Reject drops below the last valid value (recommended for energy and water counters).
data_description.invert: Multiply the value by -1 (e.g. net flow: load minus feed-in).
data_description.fallback_zero: Report 0 instead of unavailable when no source delivers a value.
data_description.fallback_on_zero: Also use the fallback source when the aggregate is exactly 0 (template idiom 'primary == 0 -> fallback', e.g. ACE 1500 discharge).
data_description.net_subtract_entity_id: Subtracted from the aggregate after summing, e.g. charge minus discharge.
data_description.fallback_source_entity_id: Alternate hardware source used when the primary is unavailable and the condition below is met.
data_description.fallback_condition_entity_id: Optional entity whose state gates the fallback. Leave empty to always allow the fallback.
data_description.fallback_condition_state: State the condition entity must match for the fallback to activate.
data_description.target_device_id: Add this sensor to an existing Abstractor device.
data_description.create_new_device: Detach this sensor from its current device and create a separate device.
data_description.logical_name: Overrides the device name for this sensor's device group. Leave empty to use the configured device name template.
data_description.entity_name: Overrides this entity's friendly name. Leave empty to use the localized default.

export_data.name: Export Abstractor Data
export_data.description: Persist and log a complete snapshot of all abstract sensor mappings and values.

import_data.name: Import Abstractor Data
import_data.description: Validate and store a previously exported snapshot. Sensor subentries missing from the installation are recreated; existing sensors are never modified or duplicated.

delete_sensor.name: Delete Abstract Sensor
delete_sensor.description: Delete an Abstract sensor subentry, its entity, and its device.

subentry_id.name: Subentry ID
subentry_id.description: ID of the sensor subentry (also listed as entry_id per entry in export snapshots).

legacy_unique_id.name: Legacy unique ID
legacy_unique_id.description: Alternative — the sensor's unique_id as shown in the entity registry. Provide either this or subentry_id, not both.
